description: Free, needs a key. Changes the saved transcription glossary that every later transcription of this account uses (brand names, people, slang spellings, doNotTranslate terms). action save: entries [{term, aliases?, doNotTranslate?}] merged by term (mode merge, default) or replacing the whole glossary (mode replace). action delete: remove terms, or all:true to clear it. Returns the glossary after the change. Read it with get_glossary.

all.description: true = delete the whole glossary. Pass this or terms.

entries.description: Terms to save: [{term, aliases?: string[] (max 10), doNotTranslate?: boolean}], up to 200 terms in total.

mode.description: 'merge' (default) adds or updates by term; 'replace' overwrites the whole glossary.

terms.description: Terms to remove (exact term text). Pass this or all.

name: update_glossary

hasMore.description: true when more items are available (paginated lists).

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page (paginated lists).

result.description: The value, when the tool returns something other than an object.

title: Save or delete glossary terms
